text:
Lara: quick check — planning to onboard 'aurora-lite-3b' into the catalog. Need licensing stamp + perf profile before we gate launch. Who's owning?
Mike: I can take perf. I'll run the short latency/cost sweep on the staging pool today. ETA end of day.
Sasha: I can handle the licensing read. Quick Q — upstream has mixed assets: weights licensed Apache-2.0, tokenizer shows CC-BY-SA. That could be a problem for hosted. @Ben can you confirm?
Ben: Ben (Legal): Noted. If tokenizer is CC-BY-SA that triggers share-alike which may block hosted distribution. I need the exact file list + upstream repo link and the manifest.
Lara: adding links: https://github.com/upstream/aurora-lite (manifest at /model_card/manifest.json). Perf targets: p50 < 100ms on short prompts and cost under $0.0008/token on xG GPU. Mike — can you run batch sizes 1,4,8 and capture peak mem?
Mike: perf command:
```
./benchmark --model aurora-lite-3b --seq 128 --batch 1,4,8 --report mem,latency,throughput
```
catalog-bot: Intake created: #INT-4021 aurora-lite-3b — needed docs: manifest, license file, sample prompts. Status: intake-open
Sasha: I'll pull the manifest and paste license snippets here. If tokenizer is CC-BY-SA we need a remediation plan (replace tokenizer or restrict hosting).
Ben: Please upload the manifest + SHA for weights to INT-4021. If CC-BY-SA is present mark the intake 'restricted-hosting' so we can treat as Dedicated/Private only.
Mike: Quick results from a light sweep on staging: p50=92ms (b1), p50=140ms (b4), p50=220ms (b8). Peak mem: 12.3GB (b1), 15.8GB (b4), 18.1GB (b8). I'll attach CSV to INT-4021.
Lara: thanks — that's within target for b1. Two follow-ups: (1) Sasha/Ben — legal ok? (2) Product — do we want this in hosted initially or private-only? @Sophie
Sophie: prefer hosted if legal allows; need small output-quality check vs our dev set. Also consider quantization to reduce mem/cost — quant-8 might help.
Sasha: license quick summary: weights = Apache-2.0, tokenizer = CC-BY-SA-4.0. Also model_card mentions 'non-commercial' examples in docs — another flag.
Ben: follow-up from legal: CC-BY-SA means hosted distribution would propagate share-alike clause — legal advises 'private-only' unless we swap tokenizer. Options: (A) ask upstream to relicense tokenizer (unlikely), (B) swap in a permissive tokenizer and run QA. Recommend (B). Marking intake as 'blocked-licensing'.
Lara: OK clear. Mike — can you try running with our permissive tokenizer (hf/permissive-tokenizer) and run a tokenization parity + perf sanity check? Low-effort diff vs upstream tokenization.
Mike: on it. Will run tokenization parity test + perf with permissive tok. ETA tomorrow morning.
Sophie: I'll prep the eval harness and small QA checklist. If perf with permissive tok is similar, product OK to proceed with private-only launch and then revisit hosted later.
Lara: :thumbsup: I'll update INT-4021 and add owners: perf -> Mike, legal -> Ben, tokenization -> Mike+Sasha, product eval -> Sophie. Thanks everyone.
